question: On July 15, 2008, Phys.org published an article about a catastrophe. Find the explosive force of this catastrophe according to Encyclopedia Britannica, then find the name of the US nuclear test that had the same yield. Your answer should only be the last word of the name of the test.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Good. Britannica indicates 15 megatons. Next, find the US nuclear test with a 15-megaton yield and return its full name before we extract the last word. WebSurfer, please search for the US test at 15 Mt.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Searched for “US nuclear test 15 megatons.” Top result: Castle Bravo (Operation Castle), yield 15 megatons of TNT. Source: Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Castle_Bravo) and multiple references note it as the largest U.S. test at 15 Mt.
